simple.meaning: רָזָה (râzâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to emaciate , i.e. make ( become ) thin (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Isaiah, Zephaniah, beginning at Isaiah 17:4. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָזָה (H7329).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רָזָה (râzâh) / H7329 is traced through Isaiah 17:4, Zephaniah 2:11 as a generated source-based concept entry.

Niph`al be made lean, Imperfect 3masculine singular יֵרָזֶה בְּשָׂרוֺ מִשְׁמַן Isa 17:4 .
